trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Sharp V-shaped central depression with narrow angular convergence and significant pixel depth relative to the horizontal plane.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular serrations along the trailing edge boundary; the inner margin of the right lobe shows higher pixel-amplitude variations than the corresponding left lobe margin.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave upward curve on both lobes; the left lobe exhibits a steeper vertical distal trajectory compared to the right lobe's more horizontal orientation.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct macro-indentation or notch on the trailing edge of the right lobe, located proximally to the median notch, disrupting the natural serration pattern.
other_distinctive_markers: Small dark protrusion or cluster extending from the distal tip of the left lobe's trailing edge.
